description: This file defines the ModerationStateFieldItemList class, a custom computed field for Drupal that manages and retrieves moderation state information for content entities, including loading revisions and updating entity states based on moderation workflow.

classes.name: ModerationStateFieldItemList
classes.description: A computed field class in Drupal that provides moderation state information for content entities, handling loading of moderation state revisions, and updating entity states based on moderation workflow.

methods.name: computeValue
methods.description: Computes the moderation state value for the entity, creating a list item if a moderation state exists.

methods.name: getModerationStateId
methods.description: Retrieves the moderation state ID linked to a content entity revision, considering entity type, bundle, and workflow.

methods.name: loadContentModerationStateRevision
methods.description: Loads the latest revision of the content moderation state associated with an entity, handling translations and revision retrieval.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the moderation state at a given index, enforcing that only index 0 is valid.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Updates the moderated entity when the moderation state changes.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the moderation state list and updates the entity accordingly.

methods.name: updateModeratedEntity
methods.description: Updates the entity's default revision flag and published status based on the new moderation state.

methods.name: generateSampleItems
methods.description: Intentionally does not generate sample items, as moderation state is always computed.
